assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The syncope episodes are accompanied by palpitations.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The condition is associated with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered.
The mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring service is billed as CPT 93229.
The monitoring is intended to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The service addresses the specific clinical indication for monitoring paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
